st-ld-dist-lakshadweep.name: Lakshadweep
st-ld-dist-lakshadweep.description: District of Lakshadweep (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Kavaratti. Population approximately 64,473 (2011 census), area approximately 30 km2.

st-ld-urban-local-bodies.name: Urban Local Bodies of Lakshadweep
st-ld-urban-local-bodies.description: The urban local self-government bodies of Lakshadweep (municipal corporations, municipalities/municipal councils and nagar/town panchayats), constituted under Part IXA of the Constitution.
st-ld-urban-local-bodies.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IXA (74th Amendment, 1992)
st-ld-urban-local-bodies.notes: Only the municipal-corporation count is directly sourced (Wikipedia 'List of municipal corporations in India', cross-validated against the national total of 273 on lgdirectory.gov.in's dashboard). Municipality/nagar-panchayat (municipal council / nagar panchayat) counts per state were not obtainable without the CAPTCHA-gated LGD per-state reports or an additional secondary source, and are left out rather than estimated.

st-ld-gram-panchayats.name: Village Panchayats of Lakshadweep
st-ld-gram-panchayats.description: The village-level tier of Panchayati Raj in Lakshadweep: one elected Village Panchayat for each of the 10 inhabited islands (88 elected members in total), under Part IX of the Constitution and the Lakshadweep Panchayats Regulation, 1994.
st-ld-gram-panchayats.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992); Lakshadweep Panchayats Regulation, 1994
st-ld-gram-panchayats.notes: Was missing from the original pass (incorrectly left out alongside the constitutionally-exempt Nagaland/Meghalaya/Mizoram, but Lakshadweep is NOT exempt under Article 243-M). Lakshadweep has a two-tier PRI system, no intermediate Panchayat Samiti. Counts from Wikipedia's 'Lakshadweep' article; not cross-checked against a primary Lakshadweep administration source.

st-ld-zila-parishads.name: District Panchayat of Lakshadweep
st-ld-zila-parishads.description: The district-level tier of Panchayati Raj in Lakshadweep: a single District Panchayat (26 elected members) combining representation from all 10 Village Panchayats, under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-ld-zila-parishads.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992); Lakshadweep Panchayats Regulation, 1994
st-ld-zila-parishads.notes: Was missing from the original pass; see Village Panchayats of Lakshadweep note. No intermediate Panchayat Samiti tier exists in Lakshadweep.

st-ld-dept-social-welfare-tribal-affairs.description: Runs welfare schemes for Scheduled Tribes, the elderly and persons with disabilities.

st-ld-dept-agriculture.description: Supports coconut and horticultural farming and agricultural extension.

st-ld-dept-fisheries.name: Department of Fisheries
st-ld-dept-fisheries.description: Supports the islands' fisherfolk, fishing harbours and marine resource management.

st-ld-dept-animal-husbandry.name: Department of Animal Husbandry

st-ld-dept-environment-forest.description: Manages coastal ecology, coral reefs and environmental clearances.

st-ld-dept-science-technology.name: Department of Science and Technology
st-ld-dept-science-technology.description: Promotes scientific research and technology initiatives for the islands.

st-ld-dept-ga-protocol.name: Department of General Administration and Protocol
st-ld-dept-ga-protocol.description: Handles VIP protocol, secretariat coordination and general administrative matters.

st-ld-dept-pay-accounts.name: Pay and Accounts Office
st-ld-dept-pay-accounts.description: Processes government salary and pension payments and treasury accounts.

st-ld-dept-police.name: Lakshadweep Police
st-ld-dept-police.description: The UT police force responsible for law and order and crime investigation.

st-ld-dept-irbn.description: An armed police battalion providing reserve law-and-order and security cover for the islands.

st-ld-electorate.description: The residents and voters of Lakshadweep, a Union Territory administered by the Union government.
